think_disclaimer: think_s is null: the scripted DOM driver has no model decisions; step wall time is machine act time, the floor under any agent run, not agent think time.
clicks_disclaimer: Selector-delivery rate for DOM-selector clicks (pointer occlusion and intercept). Vision grounding error is not measured by this oracle; see calibration E2 for the vision hit rate.
clicks_excluded_reason: click_js calls .click() on the element directly and bypass hit testing, so they are counted here and excluded from hit rate.
action_disclosure: Click hit rate covers N pointer clicks only. It excludes M js-clicks and K eval-clicks and L type actions. It is not an overall action success rate.
